title: Great product with some flaws.
body:
There are many things about the laptop that is good, for example: the weight, battery life, the high resolution display, and the keyboard. 

The keyboard feels good, you feel each press of the key making for an enjoyable typing experiences. 

The display is a high resolution, I believe 2.2k or 2240x1400, 16:10 aspect ratio, and touchscreen. This is good for a laptop because you get the benefits of having a high resolution display with good battery life. The aspect ratio is good because it has more verticality allowing you to have more things on the screen when compared to something with a 16:9 aspect ratio. The only issues with the display is that it is 60hz and not that bright (300 nits), though that is not an issue if you primarily work indoors and do not care about the refresh rate. This is an IPS panel so when compared to other OLED options on other laptops it is hard to be impressed about this display. I don't use the touchscreen so I'm not gonna comment on that. Overall, the display is still good even though when compared to others it leaves a lot to be desired.

Yeah, battery life is great. The Snapdragon X Elite doesn't consume that much power that I can go without charge for a decently long period, about 3 days.

It is light. It doesn't feel like you are carrying around bricks all the time.

title: Unexpected Shut Downs
body: This computer is fast, light-weight but not reliable. The first one I purchased did not turn on at all and had to be returned. The second device has shut down on 3 occasions unexpectedly after having it for 2 weeks which could result in lost or unsaved work. Disappointing.
